comparison.objective: Lower a bent tube level so four legs seat simultaneously in a checking fixture; candidate registers switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rigid-part pose control and multi-point simultaneous seating versus mounted sensor translation and screw tightening.
comparison.success_condition: All four legs within tight slot tolerances under self-weight, released and still 1 s; candidate requires two ≤6 mm sensed endpoints.
comparison.reason: Multi-point fixture seating is a different tested alignment ability. Candidate still lacks numeric tightening drift, torque, and exact geometry.
